scope: CTA table of self-immolation protests in Tibet since February 2009, including Beijing. This is one source's account, not an independently verified complete dataset.
notes: All 157 table positions extracted. Source numbering is duplicated at 119 and omits 109.
Incident dates normalized using the source's day/month/year convention. Valid syntax does not certify historical accuracy.
Source 'Current Status' is historical; it is not a present-day confirmation.
Approximate ages, absent values, and source anomalies are preserved. No gender inferred where not explicitly marked.
Source update stamp precedes its last incident date of 27 March 2022.
Long narrative status text is condensed to factual fields; no biographical narrative is reproduced.
